team-silent-sentinel: A standing figure with a full beard, a round cap and heavy earrings. One hand is raised beside his face holding a small bell-shaped object; the other holds a small pot at his side. His robe flares to a fluted hem, and the whole surface is a glossy deep brown. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-harvest-guardian: A woman in a red sari sits cross-legged on a dark board, holding a shallow tray heaped with grain. Four bowls of grain stand around her and a few loose stalks lie at her feet. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-the-basket-weaver: A woman in a purple patterned sari sits on a dark mat, weaving a round basket in front of her; its upright strands are not yet worked in. A small metal bowl stands at her side. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-festival-dancers: Two dancers in yellow and red. A man in a feathered red turban beats a drum slung at his waist; beside him a woman in a yellow sari balances a stack of pots crowned with a sheaf on her head and holds a white cloth in each hand. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-bankura-horse: A horse standing square on four column legs, its long neck held straight up, ears pricked and a crest between them. Bands of ornament run round the neck and over the saddle cloth; the surface is a glossy deep brown. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-horse-figurine: A standing horse with a carved mane falling down its neck, a raised tail curled at the tip and a patterned saddle cloth, in a glossy warm brown. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-peacock-shubh-labh: A pair of plaques, each shaped as a blue peacock curving round a dark medallion edged with white beads. The medallions carry the words ‘Shubh’ and ‘Labh’ in gold. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-sunset-shores: A round plaque with a seashore in low relief: an orange sun between green hills, blue waves breaking on a sandy beach and dark blue shrubs along the bottom, inside a border of red and pale triangles. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-hand-of-blue-blossoms: A plaque in the shape of an open hand, fingers up, outlined in yellow: pale blue fingers above a deep blue palm painted with one turquoise flower and white leaves. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-blue-floral-tile: A square tile on a deep blue ground with a white border, painted with white and yellow flowers, red buds and green leaves on curling stems. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-blossom-bowl: A shallow oval bowl, shown upright on its rim so its inside can be seen: white leaves and dark blue flowers with brown buds on a turquoise ground, within a white line. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-miniature-pottery: A square frame of twenty-five small compartments, each holding one miniature pot. Most are black, a few red or brown; several carry fine white lines. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-black-elephant: A standing elephant in black, its trunk curled up at the tip, with a cloth worked in raised patterns over its back and bands round its legs. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-black-ganesha-statue: A smooth, rounded figure of Ganesha in black: an egg-shaped body, broad ears spread wide and a trunk curving down over the belly, with a small point at the crown. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-mud-ganesha: Ganesha on a round pedestal, with a tall pointed crown, a trunk curling to one side and a garland of large beads hanging round him, in a mottled red-brown. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
team-twin-clay-ganeshas: Two small seated Ganeshas side by side in orange clay, each with its trunk curled across its body, its ears spread and a pointed crown, modelled in soft coils. A piece from the workshop’s team, shown from its 3D model. Its maker, place and materials are still to be recorded.
